results.method: Private clean-base reference preflight, three compiling mutation probes, full/concrete drivers and dependency audits; source/contract inspection; Stratic validation and whitespace check
results.environment: Pinned Lean 4.34.0; local hash-verified PTX ISA 9.4 manual; no model calls before freeze.
results.evidence: Private PRMT reference passes 18 universal signatures and all concrete checks, with all public definitions/proofs audited. Three mutants build and audit but are rejected by both drivers: swapped source words, omitted sign replication, omitted selector masking. Concrete arithmetic expectations include all 16 selectors at four positions, upper control bits, boundary values, guard/alias/target/decoder cases. Delimiter-aware signature generation and explicit target comparison fixed draft checker issues before freeze. Public contract gives a complete bit law and shared interfaces but no computation body or new proof hints. No accepted form or shared semantic change; source fidelity and later worker checks remain separate.
